'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a crafting material, the result of processing animal hide, at the [[church workbench]]. It's often used as an in-universe replacement for leather, being one source for [[clean paper]], the only source of [[softcover]]s, and is required in the construction of the [[furnace II]].
